The severity of the text artifact is high because it breaks the realism of a branded object.
alignment_reasoning: The fine_grained_classifier strongly confirms the class 'plastic bag' (Logit 6.77, Rank 1). All visible structural and material checkpoints passed. The object conforms perfectly to the taxonomy of a flexible polyethylene container. The only deduction is minor, acknowledging that the 'branding' checkpoint is technically present but failed in legibility, though the *presence* of printed graphics is correct.
artifact_reasoning: The image suffers from significant text generation failure. The logo and text are malformed gibberish, a hallmark of AI generation. This is a severe semantic/visual artifact (Severity 4). Additionally, there is slight blurring/compression artifacts and edge softness on the left side. While the plastic texture itself is realistic, the failure to render coherent text drastically lowers the artifact score. A real photo would have crisp, legible text or no text at all; this hybrid state is unnatural.
